_readme: RULE: the pipeline takes the largest 4:5 rectangle that fits the source and
slides it so `focus` is as centred as the boundaries allow. It never zooms in
to equalise face size — an honest difference in apparent scale beats a soft,
focus:   [x, y] fractions of the source, on the person's face.
tighten: 0.72–1.0. Only for the few frames where the full rectangle really is
too wide (a dominant background object, or a figure lost in a
landscape). Capped so it can never destroy detail.
alias:   source filename when it differs from the roster key.
note:    anything a human should know when re-cropping.

betultellioglu.note: A framed Atatürk portrait fills the left of the source and dominated the full-width crop. Tightened and shifted right so she is the subject; only an edge of the frame remains.

doganefeasci.note: Square source, face low and small. The full rectangle was almost all sky.

hamzanuriasan.note: Small figure on a pier at sunset; tightened so he is findable while the sunset survives.

kaantanyel.note: ID photo, only 295x354 in the source. Framing left wide so nothing is upscaled; this card will be softer than the rest.

omerfarukozkul.note: He is holding a chicken. Crop keeps him and part of the bird — it is a good photograph.

sidelyacam.note: Source filename uses her full name (sidelyaesmanurcam.jpg); roster key is sidelyacam.

taharemziaydin.note: Holding a large model aircraft overhead; face sits low in the frame.
